Both halves stopped being true on 2026-09-01. `depends_on(from_id, to_id)` exists, and the cross-design pin is served as `external_dependency` (core: `declare_external_dependency`), so the obvious name now means the obvious thing.

⚠️ ONE CLAUSE OF IT SURVIVES AND IS DELIBERATELY NOT CLOSED WITH IT: "1 of 70 components carries any modelled coupling, so modularity is not measurable" was still true when this was retired. The helper removed the excuse, not the work — and `fact:coupling-and-contract-are-recorded-in-vocabularies-that-never-meet` still stands on its own.
